title.narrative: NEXUS Skills and Jobs Report - 1 November 2023 to 31 October 2024

description.narrative: The Shaqo Platform, a consortium formed during the second phase of the Somali Nexus Skills and Jobs Programme with support from the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, presents this narrative report, which highlights the achievements of Year 3, using the pilot project phase (Year 1) as a baseline and building upon the successes of Year 2. The Consortium has adopted a systems approach to achieve sustainable employment for vulnerable youth. This approach acknowledges that the successful economic integration of youth into local communities depends on the collaborative capacities and actions of multiple stakeholders, including private and public sector organizations, community leaders, local governments, civil society, clan elders, and local communities themselves. By employing a systems approach, notable results have been achieved by enhancing the ecological, social, and economic capital of youth. This is done through the utilization of knowledge and evidence to expedite the development, adoption, and expansion of community-driven, contextually appropriate interventions that bolster their socio-economic prospects.

activity-date.narrative: The second year of the Shaqo platform implementation started 1 November 2023 and ended 31 October 2024

recipient-country.narrative: Shaqo platform works across the whole of Somalia.

sector.narrative: Shaqo Platform is a locally-led Somali consortium that brings together local public and private sector actors to improve youth employment. “Shaqo, which means “work” in Somali, embodies our main mission: helping Somali youth get jobs to make their lives and communities better.
